(317)ḍākki dril sgrub gsang ba snying gi dum bu bzhugs pa lags so:: :rigs kyi mkha' 'gro lnga la phyag 'tshal lo:rnal 'byor pa 'a

tei:div.tei:p: ḍākki dril sgrub gsang ba snying gi dum bu bzhugs pa lags so: : : rigs kyi mkha' 'gro lnga la phyag 'tshal lo: rnal 'byor pa 'khor ba blos btang pa: ri krod dgon pa 'grim nus pa gcig gis: yang gsang ḍākki snying thig bsgom zhing : ḍākki lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs par 'dod pas: ḍākki thod rgal gnad 'bebs su bsgrub par bya ste: de la gsum rnal 'byor bzhi ldan gyi sgo nas nyams su blang ngo : de la dang po lha'i rnal 'byor dang gcig: sngags kyi rnal 'byor dang gnyis: rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor dang gsum: las mtha'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi'o: rgya rgya rgya: de la dang po lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ni: ting nge 'jin rnam pa gsum gyi las la sbyar ro: de yang rgyu'i ting nge 'jin la brten nas bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags kyis sku gsal gdab pa ni: ngag tu: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥpadma ha ri ni sa: ra tsa hrī ya: zhes brjod pas: bdag rdo rje phag mo bsgom ste: sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: khro zhal dmar mo spyan gsum ma: spyi gtsug na phag zhal mthing kha ngur (318)bdag yas su lta ba: ral ba khams nas thungal 'phyang ba: phyag g.yas gri khug bsnams pa: g.yon pa thod pa khrag gi bkang ba thogs pa: kha ṭwām̐ ga mchan khung g.yon du bcug pa: rus pa'i rgyan drug dang me long dang dril bu'i sgra 'khrol ba: zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i brla la: g.yas bskum pa'i mthe bong gtad pa: me ri 'bar ba'i klong na ro'i gdan la phyed skyil du bzhugs par bsamam mo: de nas gtso mo bskyed nas de la bskor ba'i 'khor bskyed pa ni: shar du rdo rje ḍākki dkar: lho ru rin chen ḍākki ser: nub tu padma ḍākki dmar: byang du las kyi ḍākki ljang : bzhi po des bskor ba g.yas bskor du sga ra ra bskor bar bsam la: sngags yig 'bru bcu po 'di drag tu bzlas so: hrīḥm hā ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya:

gtso mo chos nyid ngang du 'gyur med du bsnyom mo: 'khor rnams glu dang : gar dang : skor ba dang : 'khrab pa dang : dgod pa dang : ldeg pa dang rnam 'gyur snang (319) tshogs su bsgom mo: mchan zhes drag tu zhag bdun bzlas so: gnyis pa sngags kyi rnal 'byor ni: rang gi snying gi dkyil gyi sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum kyi snying khar padma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil du: yab yum gnyis kyi sa bon la ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya brgyad kyi so sor bskor bar bsam la: de dag rnams chos skor du sga ra ra 'khor bar bsam la: gang gi rtsa sngags la: tsirta hring hring ja jaḥ zhes bzlas: mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams rang rang gi snying po di ri ri bzlas par bsam mo: de yang snying gi 'khor bar yig 'bru rnams 'khor bar bsam mo/ 'di ni ḍākki'i lus dkyil chen mo nas byung ba'o/ mchan/ ༈ gnas sgrub 'phrul gyis dum bu las: sreg snying gnad nas gzir ba dran por bshad: gang ma'i yi ge bcu pa la: 'di btags zhag bdun bzlas pas 'grub: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ha ri ni sa: phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa: ra tsa hrī ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: sarba siddhi hring hring hring : ja ja ja: zhes bzlas so: (320) de ltar gsang sngags so drug pa: zhag bdun bzlas pas rtags rnams rdzogs: 'di la bsnyen pa ma them par: las tshogs spyad kyang don med de: nus med 'dre rdung byed dang 'ar: them nas las tshogs spyad pas chog: thun bzhi bcad na dam tshig nyams: mkha' 'gro gnad kyi sgrub thabs 'di yin no: 'di min gter du sbas pa med: zhes so: de ltar zhag bdun sgrub pa yin: rtags ni 'du ba rnam gsum 'byung : khroṃ 'du mi 'du bud med du: nor dang ḍākki chos skyong 'du: sngags btsun skye bo rgyal 'bangs 'du: 'bar ba gsum 'byung ste: bdag gi shes pa 'gyur ba dang : 'gar ba dang : ldeg pa dang : 'khran pa dang : sems bde bar shar nas 'khrab snying 'dod pa rnams 'byung ngo :

de nas ting nge 'jin gyi thun 'jog rtsa na 'od 'phro bcad pas sems nyams bde lam gyi 'gro'o/ rdzogs rim dang las mtha'i rnal 'byor gnyis gzhan du shes par bya'o: de nas gtor ma btang ba ni dbus su che ba gcig la mtha' ma 'dab ma bzhis bskor ba lnga sha lnga: bdud rtsi lnga: mar: nas: khu ba: chang : sgog pa legs pa ci 'byor bran no: stong gsum gang bar snang (321) tshogs sprul nas 'bul ba ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐ padma gu ru khā hi khā hi: buddha ḍākki ni kha hi khā hi: badzra ḍākki ni kha hi khā hi: ratna ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: padma ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: karma ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: bhi shwa ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: lo ka ḍākki ni khā hi khā hi: las mkhan ḍākki ni i daṃ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: zhes 'bul lo: de nas gyer snom du bya ba'i dbyangs dang bcas rjes thod rnga dkrol zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: ma skyes rnam dag chos kyi dbyings nyid nas: zhes pa sogs kyis bstod cing 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs so: bskul bya zhing nyams skyong ngo : yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ngo : de nas bsgrub na rab zhag bdun: 'bring nyer gcig tha mas kyang zla ba gcig gis 'grub nges so: rgya rgya rgya: o rgyan padma bdag nyid la: 'di las zab pa'i chos med pas: 'di dang snying thig gnyis sbrel ni: rin chen gser gyi maṇḍal la: g.yu yi rgyan gyis bkod dang 'dra: bdag gzhan don gnyis 'grub pa ste: 'gro don dpag tu (322) med pa 'byung : ldang lhas bka' yi bya ra gyis: lan gcig dus kyi tha la: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: gcig las spel na snying khrag thang la phobs shig gter srung rnams: rgya rgya rgya: gter ston padma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter nas gdan drangs pa'o/ 'di la bsnyen dmigs sogs skur du bzhugs pa rnams dkyus su bkod pa la bla ma rig 'jin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod par mjod la tshangs pa rtsal du gsol/// /
